title: Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for the Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations.
who_can_apply: The grant applies to Small Businesses or Non-Profit Organisations.
The Program relates to the Eligible Disaster, which includes AGRN—1198 and AGRN—1212.
what_you_need: You must read and agree to the Terms and Conditions and the Guidelines.
If accepting terms on behalf of a Small Business or Non-Profit Organisation, the individual must have the authority to do so.

internal_links.text: Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations

faqs.q: What do I need to know about the terms and conditions?
faqs.a: These terms and conditions apply to the Program and the Eligible Disaster (AGRN—1198 and AGRN—1212). They must be read with the Guidelines, which are incorporated into these terms.

faqs.q: Who is bound by these terms?
faqs.a: By applying for a grant, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions and the Guidelines. Successful recipients must continue to accept them.

faqs.q: Can the terms and conditions change?
faqs.a: Service NSW may vary these terms and conditions and the Guidelines from time to time. Any action taken will be notified on the Service NSW website.
